entries.title: Fix desktop exe relay not starting
items: Retry ports on Windows EACCES (excluded port ranges), not only EADDRINUSE
Desktop shell prefers ports 39200+ to avoid clashes with :3000
Writable session data + relay.log under AppData
Open the app offline if the relay still cannot bind (Live disabled)

entries.title: Fix desktop exe port-in-use crash
items: Reuse an already-running Track Spec relay instead of crashing
Fall back to ports 3001–3009 when 3000 is busy
Stop the Electron “Uncaught Exception” dialog for EADDRINUSE
WebSocket follows the UI port when the relay serves the app

entries.title: Fix desktop exe black screen
items: Wait for the local relay before opening the UI
Electron always opens the app (not the marketing page)
Disable service workers in the desktop shell
Clearer errors if port 3000 is already in use

entries.title: Live timing suite + Update button
items: Dedicated Update button in the sidebar and mobile header
Live timing sheet with top speed per lap
Best times by class and by car (with cars used)
Track labels, stint summary, CSV/PNG export
Class ghost delta and live PB alerts
Loaded tune linked to the active session

entries.title: Desktop Live exe, light phone pack, update center
items: TrackSpec-Live.exe — double-click for UI + Live relay
Cloudflare light pack (~11 MB) with garage thumbs
Faster Garage: windowed list, slim JSON, deferred images
Drive icons fixed (front/rear axles)
In-app update checker and full changelog

entries.title: Garage performance + Cloudflare deploy
items: Slim forzaGarage-list.json for mobile
Scroll windowing so phones don’t mount 622 cards
Cloudflare Workers static deploy config
PWA refresh button (no re-add to Home Screen)

entries.title: Tuning tools + data refresh
items: Quick Tune / Manual flows with garage specs
Engine swaps from Forza Wiki
Save, share, compare tunes locally
Metric / Imperial units
Live HUD and car detect prompts
